## Validation
- [ ] `python -m ideburen.cli validate`
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m ideburen.cli build --out build`
- [ ] `python -m ideburen.cli package --input build --out build/ideburen_tables.gpkg`
- [ ] No protected personal information, credentials or unlicensed originals
- [ ] No missing data presented as zero
- [ ] GIS joins, CRS and geometry assumptions explicit
